summary: A hero steps on an anti-magic trap. JavaScript preflight_dotrap refuses ANTI_MAGIC before the move, and trapeffect_anti_magic currently has only the monster arm. Port the complete hero arm with its iron-shoes priority, resistance damage, two-dice drain, half-drain split, and trap.c:drain_en state/message/throttle order. Admit this trap type through the existing dotrap dispatcher only after those source effects are wired.

source.branch: trap.c:trapeffect_anti_magic hero arm (2323-2400) first handles positively enchanted iron shoes, then marks the trap, applies Antimagic resistance damage if active, draws d(2,6) and rnd(drain/2), lowers maximum energy when eligible, and calls trap.c:drain_en (5202-5243).
callers: trap.c:dotrap reaches trapeffect_anti_magic through the trap-effect selector; js/trap_effects.js:preflight_dotrap rejects ANTI_MAGIC before it reaches the existing monster-only function.
dependencies: trap.c:drain_en is absent in JavaScript and is required for current/max energy updates and the final You_feel message. It is a same-file source callee whose result is void but effects are essential to this selected case.
Existing wearing_iron_shoes and which_armor helpers are in js/trap_effects.js; preserve their source order before any energy draw.

The other C callers of trap.c:drain_en are mhitu.c engulfing AD_DREN and uhitm.c mhitm_ad_dren. Inspect their JavaScript production reachability; js/uhitm.js currently marks mhitm_ad_dren unported, so record that gap rather than claiming a caller witness.
